reviewer: Flow owner; source-only, no compiler or child
findings: The branch-refinement inequality has the correct direction. Every old edge has a new crossing-edge preimage; actual branch uniqueness recovers the old unordered endpoints under Sym2.map. Extra new edges mapping to old loops cause no problem for the finite image-cardinality upper bound. No unjustified vertex graph homomorphism is used.

Restricting the old center set genuinely uncontracts branches into original singletons. The resulting quotient may lack the smaller clean budget, and both exact-loss extension helpers correctly avoid requiring it. They preserve old leaf assignments, actual smallness and the precise 2(k-1)q incremental loss.

The first new star is contained in u plus original residual neighbors. The distinct old-star vertex v is outside that star, because it is neither u nor originally residual. It therefore remains an actual residual singleton after uncontracting and first growth.

Subtracting the first actual k-vertex star from T2 removes at most k candidates. The assumptions 3 eps1 d <= |T2| and k <= eps1 d supply the second 2 eps1 d threshold, with original adjacency and degree retained.

The actual final center count is |C|+1 even when u or v equals the old center. All other old leaf assignments survive both extensions. Two losses sum to 4(k-1)q and are absorbed by the extra 4kq allowance for nonnegative q.

The final at-most-one-heavy-vertex bound uses actual two-star replacement against the same finite center-cardinality maximum, and is joined with the earlier original-small-residual bound for one internally selected family. No initial family, replacement oracle or coverage hypothesis is hidden.
qualified_scope: The stated finite simple graph and parameter hypotheses are all retained; smallness and neighbor sets refer to the original host.
The exact induced dense alternative remains explicit. The chosen maximum may be empty without additional density assumptions.
Global coverage, density trichotomy and its iteration, construction runtime and the main spanner upper theorem remain open.
Strict production/root/audit/replay gates and exact remote CI are separate from this source review.
